# domain/marketing

> The marketing domain handles money-making and growth features: sellers run pay-per-click sponsored listings, and users create affiliate short links. It tracks and bills ad clicks and attributes link clicks.

`packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing` · 13 files · 7 handlers

## How it works

This unit has two halves. In **[Sponsored ad campaigns and serving](../../concepts/domain-marketing/sponsored-ad-campaigns.md)**, sellers create pay-per-click campaigns, shoppers see up to three sponsored listings per category, and each listing links to a signed redirect with daily spend counted in Redis. **[Ad click tokens and fraud checks](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md)** covers `GET /ads/click/:token`: it verifies the token, filters fraud in Redis, always redirects to the product, and publishes the click to Kafka. **[Aggregating and billing ad clicks](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md)** then counts those clicks per minute with exactly-once Kafka transactions, bills shops hourly through the ledger (`ads.bill-hour`), and corrects the totals daily from the raw click log (`ads.reconcile-day`). The share-link half starts with **[Creating and resolving share links](../../concepts/domain-marketing/share-short-links.md)**: logged-in users make short affiliate links, and `GET /l/:code` 302-redirects anyone to a marketplace page. **[Link click attribution and stats](../../concepts/domain-marketing/link-click-analytics.md)** closes the loop. Each redirect emits `link.clicked` to Kafka, a projector writes it to `ClickHouse`, and the owner reads 7-day per-minute counts from `GET /links/:code/stats`.

## Topics

- [Sponsored ad campaigns and serving](../../concepts/domain-marketing/sponsored-ad-campaigns.md): Sellers create campaigns via `POST /shops/:shopId/ads/campaigns`; `GET /ads/sponsored` serves listings, and campaign daily spend is tracked in Redis against budgets. Modules wire serving and worker parts.
- [Ad click tokens and fraud checks](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md): `GET /ads/click/:token` verifies HMAC-signed click tokens ([`signClick`](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md)/[`verifyClick`](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-tracking-and-fraud.md), 30-minute expiry), dedupes via Redis SET NX, applies per-IP burst limits, always redirects, and publishes salted clicks to Kafka.
- [Aggregating and billing ad clicks](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md): [`ClickAggregator`](../../concepts/domain-marketing/ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) writes per-minute aggregates with Kafka exactly-once transactions; `ads.bill-hour` charges hourly with ledger postings capped by budget, and `ads.reconcile-day` reconciles from raw clicks via `AdBillingRun`.
- [Creating and resolving share links](../../concepts/domain-marketing/share-short-links.md): `POST /links`, `GET /links` and `GET /l/:code` create, list and redirect short affiliate links. Codes come from a Feistel cipher over leased IDs, are stored in DynamoDB with Redis caching, and destinations are checked against open redirects.
- [Link click attribution and stats](../../concepts/domain-marketing/link-click-analytics.md): Redirects emit [`LinkClicked`](../../concepts/domain-marketing/link-click-analytics.md) events to Kafka (`links.events`); [`LinkClicksProjector`](../../concepts/domain-marketing/link-click-analytics.md) consumes `link.clicked` and inserts into the `ClickHouse` `link_clicks` table, deduplicated by `click_id`, serving `GET /links/:code/stats`.

## Key concepts

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AdCampaign` | Postgres record for a seller's pay-per-click sponsored listing campaign, owned by this domain. |
| `AdBillingRun` | Postgres record of an hourly billing run that charges shops for ad clicks. |
| Signed click token | Signed value in the ad click URL that proves the click came from a served ad. |
| Sponsored listing | A paid product placement; up to three are served per category. |
| Share link | Short affiliate URL with a code, stored in DynamoDB, that redirects to a marketplace page. |
| `link.clicked` | Event published on each share-link redirect; consumed by a projector that stores clicks in `ClickHouse`. |

## Gotchas

- The ad click endpoint always redirects the user to the product, even when fraud checks reject the click. Rejection only affects counting and billing.
- Ad clicks are not billed inline. They go through Kafka, then per-minute aggregation, then the hourly `ads.bill-hour` job.
- Hourly billing is only approximate. `ads.reconcile-day` fixes it later from the raw click log, so numbers can shift after the fact.
- Share-link clicks are stored asynchronously: redirect, then Kafka, then a projector, then `ClickHouse`. Stats can lag behind real clicks.
- Links live in DynamoDB and click aggregates in `ClickHouse`, not Postgres. Only `AdCampaign` and `AdBillingRun` are Postgres tables here.
